site.name: Railroad Valley Playa, Nevada, USA (RadCalNet site RVUS, RVUS00)

region_of_interest.definition: 1 km x 1 km square, north-up, centred on the RadCalNet RVUS site coordinates
region_of_interest.pixel_weighting: area-weighted mean; each 30 m pixel weighted by its fractional overlap with the square
region_of_interest.orientation_note: RadCalNet does not publish the square's orientation; north-up is assumed

siac_v2_run.siac_commit_note: upstream MarcYin/SIAC feat/refactor at ad2cdf2 plus the Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-1 preprocessor commit

siac_v1_run.siac_version: MarcYin/SIAC commit fc6e592 as run in our pipeline (compatibility changes only: data access, Python 3.12 / numpy fixes, AOI windowing, CAMS time-index fallback; solver unchanged); SIAC_L8 entry point, run with an AOI around the site

radcalnet.band_integration: RadCalNet 10 nm spectrum weighted by the USGS relative spectral response of the sensor band (SRF-only weighting, no solar-irradiance weighting); RadCalNet's per-wavelength uncertainty is carried as fully correlated across wavelengths within a band (upper bound) and treated as k=1, because RadCalNet publishes no coverage factor

columns.siac_v2_boa: SIAC v2 BOA reflectance, ROI mean
columns.siac_v2_roi_sd: spatial standard deviation inside the ROI (not an uncertainty)
columns.siac_v1_boa_unc: ROI mean of SIAC v1's own per-pixel BOA uncertainty
columns.usgs_l2sp_sr: USGS Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance, ROI mean
columns.radcalnet_boa_*: RadCalNet surface reflectance for the record date in the column name
columns.radcalnet_boa_unc_k1_*: RadCalNet surface reflectance uncertainty, band-integrated, k=1
